name: v5.2.14
body:
<!-- Release notes generated using configuration in .github/release.yml at 5.2.x -->

## What's Changed
### Bug Fixes 🐞
* Preserve coroutine identity for Python introductions by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13670
* Fix abstract Python WebSocket client close operations by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13668
* Fix asyncio bridge behaviour without the Netty loop and for awaited Java values by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13657
* Visit the Java class generated for a Python class once by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13659
* Keep the Python bridge state of data classes out of their declared fields by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13660
* Run async methods of Python singletons in their own context by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13661
* Python: bind AOP proxy calls through the Python signature (defaults and keyword arguments) by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13665
* Raise the original Python exception when awaiting an intercepted async def by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13666
* Python: map positional-only parameters onto the generated Java method by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13672
* Test async routes of explicitly scoped Python module scripts by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13671
* Support native Python domain exceptions in typed handlers by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13681
* Python: invoke module-level functions once when converting the result by @graemerocher in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13704
* Follow the Reactive Streams contract in CancellableMonoSink by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13682
* Treat every 1xx, 204 and 304 response as bodiless by status code by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13685
* Give each pending acquire its own max-pending-acquires permit by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13684
### Improvements ⭐
* Allow masked HTTP header tracing by logger name by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13678
* Support native Python Decimal interop by @n0tl3ss in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13696
* Run native and Python CI after Java CI and Sonar pass by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13700
### Other Changes 💡
* Name imported bean definitions after their importer only by @alvarosanchez in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13638
* Cache the CORS origin patterns and per-route @CrossOrigin configurations by @dstepanov in https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/pull/13303


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/micronaut-projects/micronaut-core/compare/v5.2.13...v5.2.14
